title: The brief's near-miss negative for a token embedded in a longer word was implemented as a match
resolution: The rule takes a word boundary before ghs_, so a token shape after a letter, digit, or underscore stays; design, deltas, proposal, and contract say so, with a negative test in both users.

title: The fail-before run stopped at the first assertion of each test and left later behaviors unshown
resolution: The positive tests are split into one test per behavior, and verification.md records each failing against the base rule and passing with the fix.

title: The record called the pass 3 reviewer of route.json a departure from governance, which assigns the same one
resolution: The route section now names the pass 3 reviewer of route.json as the one governance assigns.

title: Format evidence named a commit but linked mutable pages without pinning or an unversioned label
resolution: E1 and E4 link the pinned github/docs commit, and the rendered page, E2, E3, and E5 are labelled unversioned.
